basis: Cross-run diagnostic using unchanged Stage05 policy at4096 context plus BF16 tied head weights. Not measured full-model device time.
limitations: Layer byte estimates count selected expert8/128 reads and rounded cache reads at the profiled context; terminal adds head weights only. Embedding rows, norm/state and recorder traffic are small but omitted; controller rereads/NoC are not modeled.
Layer timings are host-wall replay medians, not device-time subtraction. Do not convert this cross-run comparison into full-model roofline percentage.
